Name: Configurable Rumble
Author: heyitsmads
Description:
A simple mod that adds configuration for gamepad (and mobile) vibration/rumble in vanilla Stardew Valley (looking at you horse riding and fishing mini game). May your hands finally rest.

I might add rumble strength config in future as well if that's something people want.

Should be compatible with just about everything. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] is highly recommended to configure the rumble options.

Manifest.Name: Configurable Rumble
Manifest.Description: Choose which vanilla actions vibrate your controller.
Manifest.Author: heyitsmads
